apis.iamcredentials: Mints credentials for a service account: access and ID tokens, signed JWTs and blobs. Its three reads (allowed locations) are not worth a hole; gcloud tolerates their refusal.
apis.sts: Exchanges one credential for a Google access token: returning a token is all it does.

batch: A batch is several requests of the API in one multipart body, each a whole request frisket cannot see: a secret's access went through one (measured).
resumable: A PUT to an upload's path is the next chunk of a resumable upload, which only continues one whose first request was already decided: a read, whatever began it.

setIamPolicy.reason: Replaces who may do what on the resource: it can widen access, to allUsers too.

getIamPolicy.reason: Reads the resource's policy, often by POST, and changes nothing.

testIamPermissions.reason: Says which of the named permissions the caller holds, by POST, and changes nothing.
